rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poorly expanded early blastocyst with difficult-to-discern/poor ICM and disorganized poor TE, consistent with 1DD; minor uncertainty and some speculative comments about collapse/artifact limit precision.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, sperm quality, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality; appropriately notes the DOR label may not fit the provided AMH/FSH and that age is favorable despite poor morphology.

Overall logic is mostly coherent, but there are internal inconsistencies in the draft portions (e.g., mention of OHSS risk due to only one oocyte, mixed discussion of day 4/stage 1 blastocyst) and some hedging between artifact versus true degeneration.

Generally aligned with IVF practice: recognizes poor prognosis of 1DD morphology, supports single embryo transfer, avoids routine add-ons, and does not overstate PGT-A in a 26-year-old first cycle; minor deviations include some speculative protocol suggestions without strong indication.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer, counseling, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and future cycle review, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
